DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,

    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.

    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",

# Outcome sub-dossier — Pinnacle Entertainment, Inc. realized record after merger with Penn National Gaming, Inc., ~3-5-year horizon (~2021-2023)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the entity was taken over and
> deregistered, there is no post-closing public 10-K under its own name; the traceable
> realized record is limited to the deregistration filing and the acquirer's periodic
> disclosures naming the acquired properties. This sub-dossier contains no information
> about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On October 25, 2018, Pinnacle Entertainment, Inc. filed a Form 15-12B certifying
  termination of registration of its common stock (and its 5.625% Senior Notes due
  2024) under Exchange Act Sections 12(g)/12(h), recording approximately one holder of
  record of common stock as of that date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058,
  Form 15-12B]
- No Form 10-K, 10-Q, or 20-F was filed under Pinnacle Entertainment's own CIK
  (0001656239) after its pre-merger FY2017 10-K (filed 2018-03-01); no periodic report
  covering fiscal years within the ~2021-2023 outcome window exists under that CIK.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058, Form 15-12B]

## Acquirer's disclosure naming the acquired properties (Penn National Gaming / PENN Entertainment, CIK 0000921738)
- Penn National Gaming's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2022 (filed 2023-02-23) states that
  in October 2018 the company completed the acquisition of Pinnacle Entertainment,
  Inc. ("the Pinnacle Acquisition"), adding 12 gaming properties to its portfolio and
  assuming a triple-net master lease with GLPI originally effective April 28, 2016
  (the "Pinnacle Master Lease"). [SRC: SEC accession 0000921738-23-000010, Form 10-K
  (FY2022)]
- The same 10-K's property table lists the 12 former-Pinnacle properties by name —
  Ameristar East Chicago, Plainridge Park Casino, Ameristar Vicksburg, Boomtown Bossier
  City, Boomtown New Orleans, L'Auberge Baton Rouge, L'Auberge Lake Charles,
  Margaritaville Resort Casino, Ameristar Black Hawk, Cactus Petes and Horseshu,
  Ameristar Council Bluffs, and River City Casino — as still operating as of December
  31, 2022, each tagged to the Pinnacle Master Lease (or the Margaritaville Lease) but
  organized within the company's own "Northeast," "South," "West," and "Midwest"
  reporting segments alongside properties the acquirer owned before the acquisition,
  rather than as a separately identified Pinnacle business unit or segment. [SRC: SEC
  accession 0000921738-23-000010, Form 10-K (FY2022)]
- The same property listing and segment structure (former-Pinnacle properties folded
  into the acquirer's Northeast/South/West/Midwest segments) also appears in the
  acquirer's FY2020 Form 10-K, indicating the integrated, commingled reporting
  treatment was already in place roughly two years after closing. [SRC: SEC accession
  0000921738-21-000009, Form 10-K (FY2020)]

## Items sought but not found
- No goodwill or intangible-asset impairment charge specifically identified as
  attributable to a former-Pinnacle reporting unit or property was located in the
  FY2022 10-K; an impairment charge disclosed for that fiscal year (Hollywood Casino at
  Greektown) is tied to a property not named among the Pinnacle-acquired assets in the
  DEFM14A or the closing 8-K, so it is not attributed to this transaction here. [SRC:
  SEC accession 0000921738-23-000010, Form 10-K (FY2022)]
- No divestiture, closure, or sale of any of the 12 former-Pinnacle properties was
  found disclosed between the FY2020 and FY2022 10-Ks; all 12 continue to appear by
  name in the FY2022 property table. [SRC: SEC accession 0000921738-23-000010, Form
  10-K (FY2022)]
- No source was found in which the acquirer separately discloses a financial
  scalar (revenue, net income, EBITDA) specifically isolated to the former-Pinnacle
  properties as a group, as opposed to the acquirer's consolidated or segment-level
  results (which also include pre-existing, non-Pinnacle properties). [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because Pinnacle Entertainment was acquired and deregistered in October 2018, there
  is no public audited outcome record (10-K/20-F) for the ~2021-2023 window under
  Pinnacle's own registration. [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058, Form 15-12B]
- The acquirer's FY2022 Form 10-K shows the 12 gaming properties acquired in the
  transaction continuing to operate roughly four years after closing, with no
  documented divestiture or property-specific impairment, but commingled into the
  acquirer's own regional reporting segments rather than tracked as a distinct
  disclosed business. [SRC: SEC accession 0000921738-23-000010, Form 10-K (FY2022)]
- Per the no-record convention, this case is coded **uncertain** on the outcome for the
  acquired business considered as a standalone entity: the absence of any
  separately-disclosed financial or operating trajectory for the former-Pinnacle
  properties as a group precludes a sourced determination of their specific realized
  3-5-year performance, beyond the fact that the properties themselves remained in
  operation and were not divested. [SRC: SEC accession 0000921738-23-000010, Form 10-K
  (FY2022)]

[SLICE END]
